Open with gentle acoustic guitar, soft fiddle and wooden flute; bring in an intimate expressive female lead, then gradually add accordion, mandolin, upright bass, hammered dulcimer and hand percussion. Organic acoustic arrangement, warm room ambience, spontaneous live celebration, minimal electronic processing.

Come in from the orchard, come in from the lane
The kettle is singing; we’ve set out the rain
Of rose-colored ribbons and apples to share
There’s room at the table, there’s room everywhere

You brought me a pear from the old market stall
And bowed like a prince by the village hall
I laughed at your shoes, all polished and brown
You spun me once and near sat us down

[Pre-Chorus]
The fiddler looked over, the candles burned bright
You asked if I’d save you the first dance tonight
I said, “If you promise to mind where you tread”
You grinned, “I’ll remember the words that you said”

[Chorus]
So turn me around where the apple trees lean
You’re the sweetest surprise that this village has seen
With a hand in your hand and our friends singing near
I could dance through the harvest and dance through the year
Hey, round we go, let the good times begin
There’s a place by my side—come and tumble right in

[Verse 2]
Your aunt brought a basket of plum-colored pies
Your brother kept missing the beat, to our surprise
The mayor wore two ribbons, one red and one blue
And the smallest child led the whole line but you

[Pre-Chorus]
The fiddler played faster; the floorboards replied
You offered your hand with a laugh in your eyes
I said, “Keep it steady, there’s still time to learn”
You bowed to the baker and waited your turn

[Chorus]
So turn me around where the apple trees lean
You’re the sweetest surprise that this village has seen

I could dance through the harvest and dance through the year
Hey, round we go, let the good times begin
There’s a place by my side—come and tumble right in

[Folk Sing-Along]
Round the table, round the square
Bring your laughter, bring your pair
One step forward, two steps wide
Everyone’s welcome inside

[Instrumental Dance Break]
Hey! Come on, now!
Round the table, round the square!

When the last red candle burns low in its cup

And the moon won’t be half as bright as your charm

[Final Chorus]
So turn me around where the apple trees lean

Hey, round we go, let the good times begin

Everyone’s welcome inside

[Outro]
There’s room at the table, there’s room everywhere
You saved me a dance—and I’ll meet you there
Round the table, round the square
Bring your laughter, bring your pair
